coverage_targets.note: The descriptor is 'Adds within 10'. The G1 Lm blueprint also puts take-away items on R1, but the rung is not defined by them, so requiring SUB here would fail a bank that is faithful to the descriptor.
Taxonomy progression stage 1, direct with no regrouping. Sums within 10 cannot regroup, so this target is met by every conforming item and fails loudly if an over-hard item is filed under R1.
Descriptor: 'Adds within 20 (crossing 10)'.
Crossing 10 is stage 4, the single-regrouping mechanism, in its smallest form. Guaranteed by the generator, which is asked for exactly one regrouping column.
Stage 7, answer-size change. A 1-digit + 1-digit sum that crosses 10 always gains a digit, so the value is structurally guaranteed rather than hoped for.
Descriptor: 'Subtracts within 20'.
Taking a 1-digit number back across ten is the subtraction half of stage 4.
Stage 7 again: a 2-digit minus 1-digit within 20 that needs the exchange always lands below ten, so the answer loses its digit. Guaranteed, not incidental.
The descriptor names both: '2-digit ± without regrouping'.
'without regrouping' is the whole descriptor. An item with a carry filed under R4 is mislevelled, and this target is what says so.
Stage 2, horizontal versus vertical. SPEC section 3.2 names column-only generation as one of the two holes the taxonomy exposed; the G2 Lm blueprint now carries both, so the target is meetable today.

Stage 3, unequal digit lengths, the second hole in SPEC section 3.2. The 2d+1d and 2d-1d alignment slots supply LONGER_FIRST. SHORTER_FIRST is left out: no blueprint generates it, and a target nobody can meet is worse than no target.
Descriptor: '2-digit addition with one regrouping'.
'one regrouping', stage 4.
Stage 2. R5 was column-only until the blueprint gained its horizontal slot; without this target the hole can reopen silently.
Stage 3. The 2d+1d alignment slot supplies LONGER_FIRST.
Descriptor: '2-digit subtraction with exchange'.
One exchange, stage 4.
Stage 2, and the rung where the horizontal-to-vertical error M_H2V_SHIFT is most likely to show.
Stage 3. The 2d-1d alignment slot supplies LONGER_FIRST.

Stage 11, efficient mental strategies. assess/tags.py assigns MENTAL to every R7 item by rung, so this target is met whenever any R7 item exists; it is here to stop a future generator quietly filing standard column work under R7.
Stage 9, missing number. The descriptor names 'missing numbers'; the missing_number generator supplies it. Missing digits are stage 9's other half and sit at R13, per SPEC section 3.1.
Stage 10, equality and inverse. The descriptor names both 'missing numbers' (INVERSE) and 'equality' (BALANCE), and the missing_number and balance_scale generators supply one each.

Stage 12. This is the only word-problem target that can be checked today: word_structure, the dimension that actually separates 'had some, gave away 13, now 24' from 'had 37, gave away 13', is not yet emitted by word_1step or word_2step. The first word_structure target belongs here the day the generator tags it.
Stage 12 tests operation selection, which is untested if every word problem on the rung runs the same way.
Descriptor: '3-digit ± with one or two regroupings'.
'one or two regroupings' is stages 4 and 5 on one rung, so both values are required rather than either.
Stage 2. Named in SPEC section 3.2 as one of the rungs generated in columns only until the blueprint was fixed.
Stage 3. The 3d+2d slot supplies LONGER_FIRST; this is the '342 + 5' case the taxonomy singles out in section 4.
Descriptor: 'Subtraction across zero'.

Stage 6, zeros. This is the rung's definition and the only value required here. zero_pattern is deliberately left untargeted: the generator produces INTERNAL or MULTIPLE depending on how many zeros the second operand happens to contribute, so pinning either one would make the target a coin toss.
Stage 2, and the G3 L0 blueprint carries an explicit horizontal across-zero slot.
Descriptor: 'Estimate first (round to 10), judge reasonableness'. assess/tags.py assigns ESTIMATION to every R11 item by rung.
Rounding a sum and rounding a difference fail differently: estimating 802 - 396 invites rounding both ends the same way. Both appear across the G3 and G4 blueprints.
The descriptor names both halves: '4-digit addition with multiple addends; 4-digit subtraction across zeros'.

Stage 8, three or more addends, which is where a column total can exceed 20 and M_CARRY_ALWAYS_1 becomes visible. Three is required rather than four because multi_add(3) is in every R12 blueprint while four addends appear only in the G4 sheets.
Stage 6 at four digits. 'subtraction across zeros' is half the descriptor, and the across-zero slots supply it.
Stage 2. The G4 L0 blueprint carries the horizontal 4d-2d slot.
Stage 3 at four digits: aligning a 2-digit number under a 4-digit one is the taxonomy's '4,382 - 7' case.
Stage 9's missing-digit half, which SPEC section 3.1 places at R13 rather than R7.
Descriptor: 'place-value reasoning under constraint'. The missing_digit generator carries it.
Descriptor: 'Chooses an efficient strategy', stage 11. assess/tags.py assigns COMPENSATION to every R13 item by rung.

The only checkable target on this rung. word_2step and word_budget carry no single operand pair, so assess/tags.py derives none of the arithmetic dimensions for them; a multi-step budget target needs either a num_steps dimension or word_structure, and neither exists yet.
Stage 13. X1 is 'Explains the procedure / judges a claim' and sits off the ladder, so it has no band position and no arithmetic target; what makes an item X1 is that it asks for a judgement.
Stage 13, 'Finds the mistake in a worked example'.
A child who can spot a forgotten carry may not spot a missing exchange; the two are different diagnoses, and the find_mistake generator is asked for each.
